commits.message:
A bundled theme's name means one palette (rich-unfiled-791c.gy3z)

`TerminalTheme.palette` was built from a theme's eight base colours, so
tokyo-night's `panel` was #38374b there and #414868 from `getThemePalette`.
A bundled constant now holds the registry's Palette itself, which moves 2,163
of 3,634 role values on a bundled `TerminalTheme`, `*-muted` and `text-*`
among them, to what the theme authored.

The contrast tests that ran on those palettes were testing `buildPalette`'s
rules, so they now run on what those rules make of each theme's bases.

An effect's hold is told by the frame's drawing, so it holds still inside a combinator (rich-animation-27tq.vmc) (#530)

* An effect's hold is told by the frame's drawing, so it holds still inside a combinator (rich-animation-27tq.vmc)

An effect's exact hold depends on what it drew, and a combinator asked nextChange(t) with nothing drawn, so an Effected in Timeline.run, sequence, repeat, map or all answered t and the host repainted every frame, even under reduced motion.

The frame's one drawing now tells the hold (RenderOptions.onMoved), and placed asks with that report (Moves), so the combinators that remapped the time carry it back. Nothing is drawn twice, so the answer cannot disagree with the frame. Effected.render and GlyphEffected.render stop being a second placement; moved, Moved and Shown.nextChange go.

* A hold a drawing told is read by the element it names, and onBeat carries it backwards (rich-animation-27tq.vmc)

* A held effect holds for good, and a measurement reports no drawing (rich-animation-27tq.vmc)

* An effect over no cell holds for good (rich-animation-27tq.vmc)
